meta.title: Projects Manager
meta.description: Clients, projects, invoices, and encrypted tool credentials for freelance developers — in one account.

hero.eyebrowLabel: Built for developers, vibecoders, freelancers, agencies, and indie hackers
hero.subtitle: Clients, projects, invoices, and the logins for tools you pay for — kept in your account, not in a spreadsheet.

mockup.label: Interactive preview of the Projects Manager app

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: How the studio is doing in the period.
dashboard.profitHint: Billed amount minus the tools you pay for
dashboard.rulerHint: Each installment in the month it is due, by project

audit.title: Audit
audit.description: History of actions taken on your account.

pains.title: The work is scattered. The money is too.
pains.subtitle: Freelancing breaks down in the gaps between tools.

scattered.title: Clients and projects live in spreadsheets
scattered.body: Names, statuses, and notes drift across tabs until you cannot tell what is still active.

invoices.title: Invoices go out and then go quiet
invoices.body: Without a payment ruler, unpaid months hide until cash is already tight.

secrets.title: Tool credentials end up in chat
secrets.body: Paid logins get pasted into messages because there is nowhere safe to keep them next to the project.

overview.title: Work and revenue never share a view
overview.body: The board says what is moving. Nothing says what it is worth this month.

features.title: Everything the studio needs
features.subtitle: One account. Your clients, your pipeline, your billing.

kanban.title: Kanban pipeline
kanban.body: Move a project across the board as the work moves, without losing the client or the money attached to it.

invoices.title: Invoices and a payment ruler
invoices.body: See which months are paid, pending, or late for every project.

finance.title: Finance dashboard
finance.body: Revenue, outstanding invoices, and the shape of the month, in one view.

secrets.title: Encrypted tool secrets
secrets.body: Store the credentials for the tools you pay for, sealed per account.

github.title: GitHub Actions on the project
github.body: Connect a personal token and read the latest workflow runs for the repository already on the project.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.body: A record of what changed, so a month later you can still see who moved what.

how.title: Three steps, then it is your system

addClient.title: Add a client
addClient.body: Keep the people you bill in a registry you can reuse on every project.

createProject.title: Create a project
createProject.body: Attach the client, the repository, and the tools that project depends on.

track.title: Track work and billing
track.body: Move the card, send the invoice, and watch the month fill in.

security.title: Isolated by default
security.subtitle: Your studio data is not mixed with anyone else's.

isolation.title: Per-user isolation
isolation.body: Every row belongs to your account. Another user cannot read your clients, projects, or invoices.

encryption.title: Envelope encryption for secrets
encryption.body: Tool credentials are sealed before they are stored, and stay attached to the project that uses them.

emailCode.title: An email code on every sign-in
emailCode.body: A password is not enough. Each login also needs a six-digit code sent to your inbox.

who.a: Freelance developers who bill clients, run a handful of projects, and pay for the tools those projects need.

data.a: In your account, on the app. This site is only the introduction.

secrets.q: Can I store API keys and logins?
secrets.a: Yes. Paid-tool credentials are encrypted per account and stay attached to the project that uses them.

start.a: Create an account on the app, confirm your email, and add your first client.

cta.title: Put the studio in one place.
cta.subtitle: Sign in if you already have an account, or create one and add your first client.

footer.tagline: Clients, projects, invoices, and tool credentials for freelance developers.
